subject: Linguagens e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Relacionar as práticas artísticas às diferentes dimensões da vida social, cultural, política e econômica e identificar o processo de construção histórica dessas práticas.

components.description_pt: Relacionar práticas artísticas específicas a dimensões sociais, culturais, políticas ou econômicas da vida
components.description_en: Relate specific artistic practices to social, cultural, political, or economic dimensions of life
components.cc_component_description: Analyze social, commercial, or political motives behind a media presentation

components.description_pt: Identificar o processo de construção histórica de uma dada prática artística
components.description_en: Identify the historical construction process of a given artistic practice
components.cc_component_description: Sequence the steps of a described historical process in correct order

components.description_pt: Analisar como contextos sociais, políticos e econômicos moldaram o desenvolvimento de práticas artísticas
components.description_en: Analyze how social, political, and economic contexts have shaped the development of artistic practices
components.cc_component_description: Interpret vocabulary describing political, social, or economic concepts in a historical text

cc_matches.description: Analyze the purpose of information presented in diverse media and formats (e.g., visually, quantitatively, orally) and evaluate the motives (e.g., social, commercial, political) behind its presentation.
Identify key steps in a text's description of a process related to history/social studies (e.g., how a bill becomes law, how interest rates are raised or lowered).
Determine the meaning of words and phrases as they are used in a text, including vocabulary describing political, social, or economic aspects of history/social studies.
